pages.text: $(li)$(thing)Cool-season:$() sow as soon as the ground thaws. Sprouts after 100 °C·d above 0 °C.$(li)Ripens after $(thing)1400 °C·d$(). Best near 18 °C; stops above 32 °C.$(li)$(thing)Frost$() kills it below -20 °C (-2 °C in flower).

$(li)$(thing)Soil pH$() 5-7 (tolerates 4.5-8). Roots 1.5 m. Some tolerance of wet soil.$(li)$(thing)Feeds on$() N 80, P 15, K 75 kg/ha per crop.$(li)$(thing)Yield$() when well grown: about 48 bu/ac (3 t/ha).$(li)$(thing)Harvest:$() Rye and Rye Seeds.
